params.name: subscriptionId
params.description: Gets subscription credentials which uniquely identify Microsoft Azure subscription. The subscription ID forms part of the URI for every service call.

params.name: resourceGroupName
params.description: The name of the resource group to get. The name is case insensitive.

params.name: applicationName
params.description: Name of the Application Insights application.

params.name: metricId
params.description: ID of the metric. This is either a standard AI metric, or an application-specific custom metric.

params.name: timespan
params.description: The timespan over which to retrieve metric values. This is an ISO8601 time period value. If timespan is omitted, a default time range of `PT12H` ("last 12 hours") is used. The actual timespan that is queried may be adjusted by the server based. In all cases, the actual time span used for the query is included in the response.

params.name: interval
params.description: The time interval to use when retrieving metric values. This is an ISO8601 duration. If interval is omitted, the metric value is aggregated across the entire timespan. If interval is supplied, the server may adjust the interval to a more appropriate size based on the timespan used for the query. In all cases, the actual interval used for the query is included in the response.

params.name: aggregation
params.description: The aggregation to use when computing the metric values. To retrieve more than one aggregation at a time, separate them with a comma. If no aggregation is specified, then the default aggregation for the metric is used.

params.name: segment
params.description: The name of the dimension to segment the metric values by. This dimension must be applicable to the metric you are retrieving. To segment by more than one dimension at a time, separate them with a comma (,). In this case, the metric data will be segmented in the order the dimensions are listed in the parameter.

params.name: top
params.description: The number of segments to return.  This value is only valid when segment is specified.

params.name: orderby
params.description: The aggregation function and direction to sort the segments by.  This value is only valid when segment is specified.

params.name: filter
params.description: An expression used to filter the results.  This value should be a valid OData filter expression where the keys of each clause should be applicable dimensions for the metric you are retrieving.

params.name: apiVersion
params.description: Client API version.

items.docs: Gets metric values for a single metric
